Messages.Author: Alex Broadhead
Messages.Body:
Howdy,

What happens when an otherwise normal minion attempts to strike for
the third time with a Weighted Walking Stick? By 'otherwise normal' I
just mean that the minion is using a base strength of 1 and not
otherwise adjusting the damage, so that each strike is for 2, and thus
removes two counters.

Relevant text (from Monger, as I don't own the card yet):

Weighted Walking Stick
Combat

Only usable before range is determined on the first round

Put this card on this minion and put 5 counters on this card. While in
play, this card represents a melee weapon (and counts as equipment
while in play). This weapon does strength+1 damage each strike. For
each point of damage inflicted by this strike (even if it is
prevented), remove a counter from this card. Burn this card when is
has no counters. A minion can have only 1 Weighted Walking Stick

I presume the answer to the question is that the strike does its 2,
the final counter remaining is removed, the 'overdrawn' portion is
ignored, and the card burns? That is, I presume that you can strike
for as much damage as you can generate with a WWS as long as it still
has at least one counter?

Also, for purposes of Thomas Steed, does the WWS count as a melee
weapon (in hand)? Pretty please?

Thanks,
Alex
